dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: ...From which direction will Stormterror appear, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry, sorry, I didn't mean to disturb you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I apologize as well. I acted on force of habit. You must be a local, yes? My name is Cyno, and I'm here sightseeing in Mondstadt. In truth, it is I who am disturbing you.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Um, might I ask if you're looking for something here?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I'm waiting for Stormterror to arrive.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: You even set up a Kamera...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Yes. I hope to capture a good picture as reference material for an artist I know.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Ah... In that case, let me help keep watch too. From what I've heard, Stormterror's movements have some... regular schedule.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Roughly how often does it appear?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Uh, hold on. I'll have to check against our data first. Let me consult my notes...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Um... Mr. Cyno, Sir, are you going to stand there staring into the sky the entire time?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm quite strong. My neck can take it.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: No, no, I mean... You should sit down. I—I brought a blanket — here, you can borrow it!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: ...Weird. Now I'm staring up into the sky, too...
